correctness.rationale: For the normalized sandwich matrix, the power formula has blocks \(A^j\), \(A^{j-1}B\), \(CA^{j-1}\), and \(CA^{j-2}B\). With \(A^j=0\) the fixed-type map \(\ker A^{j-1}\to k^r/\operatorname{im}A^{j-1}\) induced by \(A^{j-2}\) has rank precisely the number of Jordan blocks of size \(j-1\). Counting B by its image rank and C by annihilator codimension proves each summand, and orbit-stabilizer supplies its multiplicity. The full nilpotent cone is a product of the classical nilpotent matrix cone and an affine space. The sharp end-depth formula uses the regular Jordan orbit and two independent nonvanishing vector factors. Exhaustive literal-product tests agree for 18 cases, but proof is symbolic.

value.rationale: The elementwise nilpotency-index distribution is a natural finite-algebra invariant for the full family of rectangular scalar Munn algebras. The theorem supplies one exact formula for every index, every positive sandwich rank and all finite fields; exposes a sharp \(r\)/\(r+1\)/\(r+2\) depth transition and explicitly counts terminal strata; and determines the reduced nilpotent cone and its exact number of points. Unlike arbitrary small-slice computations, this is a complete motivated enumeration and structural cutoff.
